operation.description:
MUTATING operation. Verify target and authorized intent; reconcile outcome before retry. Fetches data for **multiple entities in a single request**. The request body is a JSON **array** of sub-requests; each sub-request independently reads one entity — either a single record (`show`) or a filtered list (`list`).

`POST /v2/api/multi-entity`

The response is a **single JSON object** whose keys are each sub-request's `alias` (or its `key` when no alias is given). Each value holds that sub-request's result, so one call can return, for example, an invoice together with its related requisitions.

## Sub-request fields

| Field | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| key | Yes | The entity key to read (e.g. `invoice`, `requisition`, `follow_up_reminder`). |
| action | Yes | `show` to fetch a single record, `list` to fetch a filtered list. Any other value returns `{ "error": "Action not found" }` under that alias. |
| options | Yes | Depends on `action`. For `show`: the record **id**. For `list`: a **filters object** (see below). |
| alias | No | The key under which this sub-request's result appears in the response. Defaults to `key`. Use it to disambiguate two sub-requests that read the same entity. |
| level | No | Data-detail level — how deeply related records are loaded. Defaults to `1`. Higher levels return more nested relations. |

### `options` by action

- **`show`** — `options` is the record id, e.g. `"options": "172185"`.
- **`list`** — `options` is an object of filter conditions merged into the listing query, e.g. `"options": { "order_id": "172185", "order_type": 3 }`. Any field the target entity supports may be used.

## Response

Always returns **HTTP 200**. The body is an object keyed by each sub-request's `alias`:

- A `show` sub-request → the record object (with a `custom_data` property holding the record's custom-field values, when the entity has any).
- A `list` sub-request → a paginated envelope (`data` array plus `current_page`, `per_page`, `total`, `last_page`, and page-URL fields).
- A failed sub-request → `{ "error": "<message>" }`.

Sub-requests are processed independently: a failure in one (unknown action, inactive plugin, no permission to view the record, or an otherwise invalid sub-request) is reported as an `error` object under that alias and never fails the whole call. The overall HTTP status is always `200`.

> **Permissions:** a `show` sub-request requires permission to view the requested entity; without it that alias returns `{ "error": "You are not allowed to view this page" }`.

## Authentication

Send an OAuth Bearer access token in the `Authorization` header. Also send `Accept: application/json`.

schema.description: Array of sub-requests. Each item reads one entity, as a single record (`show`) or a filtered list (`list`).

key.description: The entity key to read, e.g. `invoice`, `requisition`, `follow_up_reminder`.

action.description:
What to fetch for this entity.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| show | Fetch a single record; `options` is the record id. |
| list | Fetch a filtered list; `options` is a filters object. |

Any other value returns `{ "error": "Action not found" }` under this sub-request's alias.

options.description:
Depends on `action`.

- **`show`** — the record id (e.g. `"172185"`).
- **`list`** — an object of filter conditions merged into the listing query (e.g. `{ "order_id": "172185", "order_type": 3 }`). Any field the target entity supports may be used.

alias.description: The key under which this sub-request's result appears in the response. Optional; defaults to `key`.

level.description: Data-detail level — how deeply related records are loaded. Optional; defaults to `1`. Higher levels return more nested relations.

schema.description: An object keyed by each sub-request's `alias` (or `key` when no alias was given). Each value is the result of one sub-request.

additionalProperties.description: Result for one sub-request — one of three shapes depending on the sub-request's `action` and whether it succeeded.

oneOf.description: `show` result — the requested record's fields, plus a `custom_data` object holding its custom-field values (present when the entity supports custom fields). The exact fields depend on the entity.

custom_data.description: The record's custom-field values, or null when it has none.

oneOf.description: `list` result — a paginated envelope of matching records.

data.description: The matching records. Fields depend on the requested entity and `level`.

from.description: Index of the first record on this page (null when empty).

next_page_url.description: URL of the next page (null on the last page).

prev_page_url.description: URL of the previous page (null on the first page).

to.description: Index of the last record on this page (null when empty).

oneOf.description: Failure for this sub-request. The other sub-requests are unaffected and the overall status stays `200`.

error.description: Human-readable reason, e.g. `Action not found`, `Plugin <name> not active`, or `You are not allowed to view this page`.

401.description:
The request has no valid OAuth Bearer access token. Send `Accept: application/json` to receive this JSON body; without it an HTML error page is returned instead.

Note: this is the only case that fails the whole request. Per-sub-request problems (unknown action, inactive plugin, no view permission) are reported inside the `200` body, not as a `401`.

message.description: Present when the request is unauthenticated (missing or invalid access token). Example: `Unauthenticated.`
